findings.description: Base UI Collapsible API misuse: Line 231 uses controlled mode with `open={isOpen}` but omits required `onOpenChange` handler. When using Base UI's Collapsible in controlled mode, both `open` and `onOpenChange` props are required. Without `onOpenChange`, the component will not respond to state changes correctly and may fail to animate. Fix by adding `onOpenChange={() => {}}` or by refactoring the trigger pattern.

History timeline uses non-stable React key: Line 95 uses `key={`${entry.at}-${index}`}` combining timestamp and array index. This is fragile if history entries are ever reordered or entries have identical timestamps. Use a stable unique identifier per entry if available from the data model.
